title: Algonquin Provincial Park Full Day Trip
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: The total travel time is 13 hours, of which 6 hours are for travel.
We recommend the use of spray to repel mosquitoes, as they abound due to the environment of this park.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Escape the city and explore Algonquin Provincial Park on a full-day trip from Toronto. Enjoy scenic lookouts, an easy guided hike, the Visitor Centre, wildlife viewing, and breathtaking Canadian landscapes. Experience one of Ontario's most beautiful natural destinations in every season.

Famous for its forests, lakes, and wildlife, Algonquin is a paradise for nature lovers and photographers. You may spot moose, loons, beavers, and other native species while discovering why it's one of the top day trips from Toronto.
